rows.notes: Q3 2026 results release (8-K EX-99.1). Study population described as 'adults with Parkinson's disease and motor fluctuations'. MAD portion has no timing.
rows.quote: The trial continues to assess safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and exploratory clinical measures of motor function, with topline data from the single-ascending-dose portion expected in the first half of 2027.
rows.rt_reason: Read SEC EX-99.1 (Serina Q3 2026 results, 2026-11-12, 'NYSE American: SER'). Quote verbatim: 'The trial continues to assess safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and exploratory clinical measures of motor function, with topline data from the single-ascending-dose portion expected in the first half of 2027.' H1 2027 window correct; dosing in Cohort 2 of the SAD portion is underway. The study population is stated as 'adults with Parkinson's disease and motor fluctuations'; 'advanced Parkinson's disease' appears only in a CEO quote about the drug's potential.

rows.notes: Q3 2026 results release. Part B topline readout mentioned only as cash-runway milestone with no date (no row). Safety-only interim.
rows.timing_stated: planned for the first half of 2027
rows.quote: An interim safety readout for Part A of the Phase 3 IMPROVE-PAH study (n=50) is planned for the first half of 2027.
rows.rt_reason: Read SEC EX-99.1 (Inhibikase Q3 2026, 2026-11-10). Verbatim: 'An interim safety readout for Part A of the Phase 3 IMPROVE-PAH study (n=50) is planned for the first half of 2027.' Drug IKT-001, PAH match. Safety-only interim, labelled as such. Part A is ~140 patients in total; the interim covers n=50. The Part B topline has no date (cash-runway wording only), so correctly omitted.
